low-cost dentals + spay/neuter. bbawc.org/clinic, (917) 426-3335.

Book online only; reception is very limited. Spay/neuter appointments are open to owned and homeless cats; the rescue clinic's exams are for homeless cats. Appointments are paid in advance, refundable with 24 hours' notice.
